title: 3677. Count Binary Palindromic Numbers

examples.explanation: The integers k in the range [0, 9] whose binary representations are palindromes are: 0 → "0" 1 → "1" 3 → "11" 5 → "101" 7 → "111" 9 → "1001" All other values in [0, 9] have non-palindromic binary forms. Therefore, the count is 6.
Since "0" is a palindrome, the count is 1.
